reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about atomic mobility, compositional fluctuations, strain, and their effect on melting in Fe–Ni–Cr–Co–Cu nanoparticles, but no cited evidence is provided to support any of these premises. The proposal relies entirely on unsupported assertions.
